title: Refiling Fee Basis and How the Replaced Certificate Ended: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44)
content:
**Rule.** Under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), a reinstatement refiling replaces a certificate whose SR-26 was transmitted for a cancellation of its since-reinstated backing term. The refiling fee for it is built on a refiling fee basis. That basis follows how the replaced certificate's coverage with the state ended, read from the replaced certificate's SR-26 date and certificate end date.

| Replaced certificate | Refiling fee basis |
|---|---|
| carries an SR-26 date, and its certificate end date is on or after the refiling date (the state still treats the driver as certified) | half of Cardinal Point's flat refiling fee, rounded up to the next whole dollar |
| its certificate end date is before the refiling date by more than 30 days (its certification with the state lapsed well before) | one and a half times the flat refiling fee, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| its certificate end date is before the refiling date by 30 days or fewer | the flat refiling fee itself |

**Boundaries (refiling on day 0)**

| Certificate end date | Basis |
|---|---|
| day 0 or later | half, rounded up |
| 1 day before day 0 | the flat fee |
| 30 days before day 0 | the flat fee |
| 31 days before day 0 | one and a half times, rounded down |

**Rounding demonstrated on hypothetical flat fees (not schedule values)**

- *Flat fee of 27.00.* Half is 13.50, rounded up to 14. One and a half times is 40.50, rounded down to 40.
- *Flat fee of 26.00.* Half is 13.00, already a whole dollar, so it stays 13.
